_about: Text for training and evaluating the 'Nexus' wake-word model (scripts/train_wake_model.py). Positives are spoken by every Kokoro voice (and blends of voices); negatives teach it what is NOT the wake word: ordinary speech in English, Hinglish and Hindi, and words that sound close to 'Nexus'. *_ipa entries are phonemes, so the same word is also said the Indian way.
